summary: Sidus Space Inc. filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026, announcing the appointment of Alan Khalili as CFO effective July 27, 2026, under an employment agreement dated July 22, 2026. Terms include a $450,000 base salary, 50% annual discretionary bonus, and 50,000 restricted stock units vesting upon conditions. Severance of six months' base salary applies if not renewed or terminated without cause, increasing to twelve months after July 27, 2027. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or abrupt change. The prior CFO's departure is not disclosed. What to watch: standard onboarding, no event-driven risk-arb angle.
